desc: A place of higher learning, the Great Madrasa provides a place for our most esteemed scholars to spread their knowledge on medicine, architecture, and Islamic law.
entities.name: Great Madrasa

desc: Dedicated to the god of war, Huitzilopochtli, and the god of rain and agriculture, Tlaloc, the Great Temple of Tenōchtitlan with its stepped construction will allow us easy expansion in the future.
entities.name: Great Temple of Tenōchtitlan

desc: A place providing plenty of housing, the Great Valley Complex will help us with the exploitation of resources in Great Zimbabwe.
entities.name: Great Valley Complex

desc: The Greek-Latin Academy is a center of education for the teaching of the languages of Antiquity, along with grammar, poetics, and rhetoric. It appeals to both intellectual and pleb due to its diversified curriculum and affordable prices.
entities.name: Greek-Latin Academy

desc: A garrison for the Amazigh tribes to rest in, allowing for a better protection of the area.
entities.name: Jayš Garrison

desc: Local artisans will always have trouble making their products reach enough people if there is too much competition. As such, associations of them tend to establish guilds where they can decide on how a certain good has to be produced and distributed.
entities.name: Guild Hall

desc: Dedicated to the production and maintenance of firearms, the Gunsmith produces various quality firearms as well as related components such as barrels, locks, and triggers.
entities.name: Gunsmith

desc: The ever-increasing demand of guns for our armies requires us to increase the capabilities of the Firearms production.
entities.name: Guns Workshop

desc: Guru Gaddi, meaning seat of the Gurū, is where the spiritual leader of Sikhism resides.
entities.name: Gurgaddi

desc: To ensure the continued prosperity of our government, we shall establish a new system of education for our elite. With a newly established separate institution, we can ensure access to the highest quality tutors while keeping their efforts centered on those who deserve it the most. With our government supported by these efforts, in time this will inspire our population to aspire to the same level of education.
entities.name: Gymnasium

desc: Primitive metal tubes which were a lesser form of later, more advanced guns. First developed in China, the early hand cannon spread to Goryeo and Japan in 1270.
entities.name: Hand Cannon Guild

desc: Run by the Hanseatic League, this trading office is a vital cornerstone for facilitating lucrative commerce between northern European cities and overseas markets.
entities.name: Hanseatic Kontor

desc: This building designates the presence of experienced Hanseatic shipbuilders.
entities.name: Hanseatic Shipwright Guild

desc: The beating heart of our merchant union, the town hall is a symbol of our widespread wealth and gravitas.
entities.name: Hanseatic Town Hall

desc: A magnificent Baroque abbey located on the island of Chiemsee. It serves as a beacon of religious and cultural prominence, boosting literacy and promoting Bavarian traditions.
entities.name: Herrenchiemsee Abbey

desc: The Hexamilion Wall, meaning ''Six-Mile Wall'', has existed since the ancient times in order to protect Morea.
entities.name: Hexamilion Wall

desc: The Hippodrome stands as the beating heart of Constantinople, where thunderous races, imperial ceremony, and the will of the people converge beneath the gaze of the ruler. Here, fans and contestants alike clash not only for glory upon the track, but for influence within the realm itself. Monuments seized from across the Mediterranean coasts adorn its spine, proclaiming dominion and legacy. Yet this grand arena is more than spectacle; indeed it is a crucible of public opinion, where acclaim can exalt a ruler for generations to come.
entities.name: Hippodrome

desc: Whether for war or for pulling the carts that carry our trade across the country, horses are needed everywhere. For this reason, families have begun breeding these magnificent steeds to meet these demands.
entities.name: Stud Farm

desc: The history of the Hospital is old as many ancient civilizations had their own version of an institution which houses the sick. During the medieval period, the Hospital evolved further as it now focuses additionally to the health care and recovery of its patients.
entities.name: Hospital

desc: A building to house a permanent [
], to keep it central and under better control.
entities.name: House of Parliament

desc:
An Imperial Armory provides the Emperor with manpower for their armies.

Turns into Imperial Armory (Domestic) when the [
entities.name: Imperial Armory (Abroad)

desc:
An Imperial Armory provides the Emperor with manpower for their armies.

Turns into Imperial Armory (Abroad) when the [
] is no longer owned by the Emperor.
entities.name: Imperial Armory (Domestic)

desc: Erected in the settlement's main gate, the Burgtor is a beautiful testament to our expertise in defensive matters as well as an astonishing display of our architecture and military capabilities.
entities.name: Burgtor

desc: An elaborate royal complex originally commissioned by Zan Abu Al Mawahib Al Hasan Ibn Suleiman. This residence featured beautiful Swahili architecture, and is used for royal as much as mercantile duties, serving as the capital's de facto bargain and storage halls for the many merchants across our domain.
entities.name: Husuni Kubwa

gate: does not own any copy of building type type

desc: The Ibadat Khana - ''House of Worship'' - serves as a meeting place for spiritual leaders of diverse religions to engage in discussions and debates on religious teachings. It aims to foster understanding among different faiths, leading to the conclusion that all religions share a common goal.
entities.name: Ibadat Khana

desc: The Imperial Academy of Arts is a dedicated institution with the mission to promote, inspire, and foster international influences in visual arts and architecture. This is achieved by sending notable painters and architects abroad, inviting guest lecturers, and continuously promoting the principles of Neoclassicism.
entities.name: Imperial Academy of Arts

desc: The Imperial City of Huế is a walled enclosure within the citadel of the capital and serves as the seat of the imperial family of Đại Việt.
entities.name: Imperial City of Huế

desc: A massive complex of shipyards, dry docks, iron foundries, spinners, and even a hospital and a prison, this can truly be the fleet base of an empire.
entities.name: Imperial Arsenal

desc: Improvements to the Charcoal Burning process allow us to output greater quantities and have a more efficient conversion rate.
entities.name: Charcoal Burner

desc: The Incamisana is a temple in honor and worship of water and the divine patrons of it. As a combination of architectural beauty and technical ingenuity, the Incamisana has a dual purpose of being a religious building and an irrigation system.
entities.name: Incamisana

desc: The Institute of Noble Maidens is a facility devoted to the education of noble women. Children are admitted at the age of six and remain within the confines of the institute for several years to ensure they are unaffected by out-of-institute influences.
entities.name: Institute of Noble Maidens

desc: Tools made from Iron will be sturdier than any other known production while not requiring the same time-consuming crafting process.
entities.name: Iron Foundry

desc: Utilizing blast furnaces, the Iron Mill will produce Tools at much higher quantity than any other method available.
entities.name: Iron Mill

desc: The proper cultivation of our land is key to feeding our people and achieving prosperity. Extensive Irrigation will secure much-needed food.
entities.name: Irrigation

desc: A seat of Italian administrative tradition that extends the reach of governance over distant territories. Rooted in the civic institutions and legal culture of the Italian city-states, it imposes order and legitimacy on the lands it oversees.
entities.name: Italian Administration Center

desc: The local building where young slaves receive the military training to become a Janissary.
entities.name: Janissary Barracks

desc: Jesuits educate our population with a proper Catholicism education, reinforcing our conversion efforts with their presence.
entities.name: Jesuit College

desc: The manipulation of gems, and valuable stones into jewels of the highest quality, makes the Jewelers' Guild a sought-after occupation due to its perceived profit.
entities.name: Jewelers' Guild

desc: A district for the Judaism people to reside in.
entities.name: Judaism District

desc: These barracks serve as a meeting point for our soldiers, to prepare for battle, train our skills and maintain our proud traditions.
entities.name: Jurchen Barracks

desc: The training ground for all those who learn the martial arts of Kalaripayattu. It also serves as barracks under the regulation of the Nair.
entities.name: Kalari

desc: Kastellet is a star-shaped fortress in Copenhagen, designed to protect the city from both land and sea attacks, featuring five bastions connected by thick walls, surrounded by a moat.
entities.name: Kastellet

desc: A large reservoir of water, these structures will allow greater agricultural investment and grant us the ability to feed our population more reliably. Once constructed, these Barays will need close supervision and constant maintenance to avoid decay.
entities.name: Baray

desc: Skillful masters of shaping palm wood and cotton into sea-faring vessels, this building facilitates the expansive navy under our command, supporting our maritime endeavors.
entities.name: Kilwan Shipwrights

desc: The administrative center for judicial matters. Used by the Council of the North.
entities.name: King's Manor

desc: The provincial governorships assigned to rule over the many provinces of Japan, the position gives great power and influence to the family assigned to them.
entities.name: Kokufu

desc: Our armies need a steady supply of troops to keep them in prime condition. Having local centers of recruitment and training will allow us to have easily available reserves.
entities.name: Korean Barracks

desc:
The Korean Gunnery is a defensive modification which enhances the fortification and increases its effectiveness against invaders over land or sea.
Mutually exclusive with Land Gunnery.
entities.name: Coastal Gunnery

desc:
The Korean Gunnery is a defensive modification which enhances the fortification and increases its effectiveness against invaders over land or sea.
Mutually exclusive with Coastal Gunnery.
entities.name: Land Gunnery

desc: The Kremlin fortress acts as an administrative and spiritual center, as well as a symbol of authority to match our growing influence. It provides crucial shelter for the population against raids and sieges due to its imposing size and formidable walls and towers.
entities.name: Kremlin

desc: Kronborg Castle, located at the entrance of the Öresund Strait, has historically served as a key fortress for controlling and collecting sound dues from vessels navigating between the Baltic Sea and the North Sea.
entities.name: Kronborg

desc: Being the main garrison of a military province, this headquarter allows its governor to prepare their armies in case of a war, and protect the realm from any invader.
entities.name: Kurmina Headquarter

desc: The Kurultai is the symbol of the local council's authority, serving as an arbiter of important decisions and the mustering of men for the army.
entities.name: Kurultai

desc: Combining sap from lacquer trees in multiple layers, gives the produced items their signature glossy finish, in a Lacquerware Artisans' Guild. Such sought-after high quality items include furniture, ceremonial boxes, and more. Lacquerware is highly valued for its beauty and resilience.
entities.name: Lacquerware Artisans' Guild

desc: Refinements of the process of painting and applying the lacquer make Lacquerware cheaper and quicker to produce.
entities.name: Lacquerware Manufactory

desc: A small hospital in an isolated location, usually in the countryside, an island, or a patch of the coastline. Maritime travelers are quarantined there if they are suspected to be carriers of a contagious disease, limiting the spread of epidemics drastically in the location.
entities.name: Lazaretto

desc: These secular institutions are studying and meeting places for scholars and the wealthy, where they can research many topics and learn about philosophy, mathematics, religion, and science. They can be independent but will often be linked to the patronage and influence of a University.
entities.name: Library

desc: Sitting as one of the greatest educational centers in Vijayanagar, this library will allow for our populace to be further educated.
entities.name: Library of Vijayanagar

desc: The Lieutenancy is the seat of the lieutenant, a royal delegate who governs a distant territory in the name of the crown. It shares the same governor cap as the Local Governor, reflecting its role as an Iberian alternative to standard provincial administration rather than an additional layer of government.
entities.name: Lieutenancy

desc: The Lighthouse of Alexandria was a towering marvel and one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Recently rebuilt, it now stands as a modern homage to its ancient legacy, guiding ships into Alexandria's harbor once again.
entities.name: Lighthouse of Alexandria

desc: La Llotja, a stunning architectural masterpiece, consists of three parts, including the '''Sala de Contratació''', a lavishly decorated trading hall with twisted columns where merchants can negotiate contracts, and the Pavilion of the Consulate that serves as the seat for the '''Tribunal del Mar'''. The central tower of La Llotja is used as a prison for debtors.
entities.name: La Llotja de la Seda

desc: Commoners are at the mercy of the government, but they are not always completely separated from it. Assembling locally among themselves allows them to discuss the most important issues affecting them, and raise their concerns to the proper authorities.
entities.name: Local Assembly

desc: The power base of the Nobility lies in their extensive properties, generally agricultural lands that the peasants exploit, either through servitude or through rent.
entities.name: Local Estates

desc: A seat of regional authority that extends the reach of the state to its most distant lands, expanding its influence beyond its immediate surroundings. When connected to the capital by the road network, they act as hubs for governance and administration.
entities.name: Local Governor

desc: No matter how isolated a settlement is, there are always people willing to travel to and from it to carry any goods and supplies the settlement may need, and profit from what it can produce. These merchants establish markets locally to allow the commerce flow.
entities.name: Local Markets

desc: Information is knowledge, and knowledge is progress. Local newspaper agencies will thus help disseminate information about the current estate of events to the populace, to the benefit of all.
entities.name: Local Newspaper

desc: While they enjoy living apart from the urban centers to not have to share their space with commoners, nobility still wants to be actively involved in the events occurring inside main towns and cities, especially when it concerns to governance. As such, it is not uncommon for them to own residences everywhere they can gain from having influence in.
entities.name: Local Noble Delegation

desc: An educated populace is a productive one. As such, local schools will help educate the commoners and put them on par with the higher classes. It is thus of no one's surprise that they tend to favor such schools everywhere they can.
entities.name: Local Schools

desc: Religion usually have places with significant spiritual relevance. In those places, the clergy will be quick to build local shrines to make sure that the population reveres these places properly.
entities.name: Local Shrine

desc: Mother Earth is abundant in metal resources, but little can be done with them unless they are smelted first. As such, smelters tend to be established near where the metals are extracted, to prepare them for easier transportation and further processing elsewhere.
entities.name: Rural Smelter

desc: Being able to feed fiber crops to the worms in order to create silk, this location has managed to achieve an autonomous production method, one that does not depend on the Silk road.
entities.name: Luccan Silk Production Guild

desc: Wood, by itself, has relatively low value unless it is cut into useful planks. To maximize its utility and ease of transportation, lumber mills are developed, allowing planks to be easily made from chopped trees.
entities.name: Lumbermill

desc: As members of the The Reformation, the Lutheran Preachers represents the local missionaries of the Lutheran faith who spread their teachings to all nearby Catholic people.
entities.name: Lutheran Preachers

desc: A center of knowledge dedicated to the promotion of studies, madrasas gather within their walls many students, many of them having often come from afar. Both earthly and religious matters are discussed inside, and their wisdom is for all to hear.
entities.name: Madrasa

desc: The Magistrato alla Sanità is a public health authority responsible for overseeing and managing measures to prevent and control the spread of diseases, particularly plague.
entities.name: Magistrato alla Sanità

desc: Built with the intention of allowing many scholars from all over the globe to experience our culture, this Madrasa is seen as one of the greatest religious colleges in Deccan.
entities.name: Mahmud Gawan Madrasa

desc: Barracks that house elite slave units. These facilities are equipped with the necessary amenities that will assist foreign slaves in learning our ways, studying religious texts, and training to become a disciplined warrior.
entities.name: Mamlūk Barracks

desc: By having the right over the roads in this location, the Maniots, who are a group of bandits within Morea, control much of the administration and trade there.
entities.name: Maniot Toll Guards

desc: As trade hubs are needed to gather all the trade in specific areas, they emerge to fulfill that role and give rise to small burgher communities.
entities.name: Market Village

desc: The increased volume of goods that flow to and from our markets, demand an increase in our capacity to store them, through the construction of a Market Warehouse.
entities.name: Market Warehouse

desc: A vibrant place of commerce where goods from near and far are exchanged, providing the lifeblood for local and regional trade.
entities.name: Marketplace

desc: Manned by skilled workers who cut and shape stone for construction, the Mason is essential for the construction of durable and lasting structures.
entities.name: Mason

desc: With the rise of the Scientific Revolution, the field of medicine is making new breakthroughs and growing in its methods and acquired knowledge. The Medical School ensures that this knowledge is passed to new generations of physicians.
entities.name: Medical School

desc: A chapel attached to an urbanized community, sponsored by the wealthy merchants who profit from ongoing mercantile traffic. It is a place of worship dedicated to a patron saint and operates as a vault of knowledge for manuscripts and scripture alike.
entities.name: Merchant Guild Chapel

desc: Trade and commerce is what makes an economy flow. To make it flow naturally and more efficiently, traders organize themselves in guilds so that there is no obstruction among their different trade routes and instead all of them contribute to make the flow stronger.
entities.name: Merchants' Guild

desc: Bustling with traders, these quarters house shops and storage, serving as the economic heart where deals and exchanges flourish.
entities.name: Merchants Quarters

desc: A Mercury Patio is a complex of buildings used to refine silver and gold extracted from lower quality ores, making them profitable.
entities.name: Mercury Patio

desc: Miaphysitism is full of rites and ceremonies that have been performed since the beginning of Christianity. Monasteries are the keepers of those rites, as only within their walls is the word of God diligently and meticulously studied.
entities.name: Miaphysite Monastery

desc: The Vatican Apostolic Library is the vast library of the Holy See. It possesses collections of information and documentations from the classical period all the way to the current day.
entities.name: Vatican Library - Military Wing

desc: The Minting Office is the main manufacturing building which creates the currency of the state. Different metals enter the office to be forged into coinage for the public.
entities.name: Minting Office

desc: The Mission is the local center for religious ambassadors and missionaries who aim to convert the local natives to the one true faith.
entities.name: Mission

desc: The growth of towns and cities and the increased governmental needs consequently require an expansion of the building housing the local authorities, to be able to continue performing their function adequately. The increased size of archives and registers are all to serve as an expansion of the authority of the court itself.
entities.name: Expanded Council Hall

desc: A place for seclusion and contemplation, monasteries are a refuge for those that want to dedicate their lives to communion with the heavens. Their grounds are thus for study and reflection, and great knowledge is usually guarded behind their walls.
entities.name: Monastery

desc: The Moscow Artillery Yard is a center for technological innovations in artillery production. Engineers and craftsmen working in the yard contribute to the development of new designs and improvements in artillery technology.
entities.name: Moscow Artillery Yard

desc: The Moscow Orphanage is a social initiative and experiment to mold abandoned children into ideal citizens. They are provided food and shelter in addition to basic education. Extended training opportunities are offered in factories or government offices once reaching adolescence. The orphanage is somewhat prone to high mortality rates.
entities.name: Moscow Orphanage

desc: The Baroque expansion of the Munich Residenz reflects the splendor of the Enlightenment era. Lavish gardens, grand halls, and intricate designs emphasized the artistic and political dominance of the Wittelsbach dynasty in Bavaria and beyond.
entities.name: Baroque Munich Residenz

production_methods.name: Early Capital Buildings with Silver Decorations

desc: This marks the foundation of the Munich Residenz, the future seat of Bavarian rulers. Constructed as a stronghold to protect against rebellious subjects and rival factions, this building symbolizes the beginning of Bavarian power and authority centered in Munich.
entities.name: Medieval Munich Residenz

production_methods.name: Early Capital Buildings with Silver Decorations

desc: During the Renaissance, the Munich Residenz underwent significant expansion, showcasing the grandeur and cultural achievements of Bavaria. This architectural masterpiece added halls of art and sophistication, elevating the prestige of Munich as a cultural hub of the Holy Roman Empire.
entities.name: Renaissance Munich Residenz

desc: A whole section of the coast has been enclosed and specialized for the construction and maintenance of our grand fleet. This small city of sailors, craftsmen, and engineers is capable of building entire navies by itself, making it one of the most important strategic centers of our country.
entities.name: Naval Base

desc: The natural evolution of defensive warfare has culminated in the development of intricate coastal defenses, ready to repel even the heaviest of hostile invasions.
entities.name: Naval Battery

desc: A seat of regional authority that extends the reach of the state to its most distant lands, expanding its influence beyond its immediate surroundings. When connected to the capital by the road network, they act as hubs for governance and administration.
entities.name: Naval Governor

desc: Naval Supplies represent everything needed in ship construction, from basic wood to tar, ropes, linen, sails, and various other materials. While a vast and diverse trade good, the Naval Supplies Guild covers all the materials needed for ship building.
entities.name: Naval Supplies Guild

desc: Similar to the Naval Supplies Guild, so does the Naval Supplies Manufactory focus on the production of Naval Supplies. Thanks to its increased dimensions, the output of available supplies for the ship construction is significantly higher.
entities.name: Naval Supplies Manufactory

desc: The steady increase in trading across the globe requires more Naval Supplies than ever before and dedicated mills are required to supply it.
entities.name: Naval Supplies Mill

desc: Naval Supplies play a vital role in the supply and upkeep of our maritime ambitions. With bigger production spaces we will be able to maintain our position and increase our output.
entities.name: Naval Supplies Workshop

desc: These medium-sized fortifications are used by the local nobility to exert their influence over their ancestral land and control the peasantry.
entities.name: Nobility Fortifications

desc: A key aspect of noble power is the ability to administer justice within their domains. This is carried out by a network of officials who enforce the laws of the nobility in their lands.
entities.name: Noble Courts

desc: Nobility pride themselves with being separated from and above the normal rabble. As such, they enjoy having residences far away from major urban areas, but those residences will be magnificent and lavishly furbished nonetheless.
entities.name: Noble Villa

desc: One way nobles publicly demonstrate their devotion is by sponsoring temples in their territories. These are usually staffed by clergy who belong to their dynasty or are very close servants.
entities.name: Noble Sponsored Temple

desc: Nobles typically use several residences, scattered throughout their domains, but also located in important centers of power. These mansions are the backbone of their estates and require constant maintenance of property and staff, ready to serve their lords.
entities.name: Noble's Mansion

desc: Nobility amass quite a bit of wealth, possessions that they want to protect. As a result, they tend to have their own personal guards and even army-ready troops, that they recruit from the local population into their direct service.
entities.name: Nobles Recruitment Center

desc: The Netherlandish shipyards have the advantage of being able to hire from the best artisans and engineers of Europe making them very efficient and capable.
entities.name: North Sea Shipyards

desc: The Novodevichy Convent serves as a refuge for noble women who have been forced to take the veil, and also strengthens the defensive capabilities of Moscow with its formidable walls and watchtowers.
entities.name: Novodevichy Convent

desc: The Falaj is an underground aqueduct system that allows us to safely transport water to any location.
entities.name: Falaj

desc: The Nizwā Fort is a vital spot for the Incense trade in Oman.
entities.name: Nizwā Fort

desc: Magnificent and ornate buildings specialized in the display of opera performances and usually built thanks to the patronage of wealthy and influential individuals.
entities.name: Opera House

desc: An Order Commandery is a building owned by the military orders outside their own territory that serves two purposes: getting revenues from the exploitation of the surrounding lands and drafting new members for the order.
entities.name: Order Commandery

gate: country rank level GREATER THAN EQUAL

desc: The residence of the Grand Master serves as the base of the Orders operations and is its political center.
entities.name: Order Headquarters

desc: A fortified base of the military orders, strategically positioned for defense and as a launching point for crusades or territorial control.
entities.name: Order Stronghold

desc: A resting place for wealthy merchants from overseas, these quarters serve as their permanent residence in India.
entities.name: Portuguese Quarters

desc: Orthodoxy clergy tend to have a strong grip on power and authority, and their monasteries serve as the seat of such power. Being under the protection of the icons they hold, they are the custodians of the country's traditional values.
entities.name: Orthodox Monastery

desc: The Ostrog is a small, wooden fortification which is constructed in remote territories of Russia. Due to their reliance on lumber, Ostrogs are relatively inexpensive and swift to construct.
entities.name: Ostrog

desc: The Overseas Trading Post is an outpost of ambitious merchants who seek their luck and fortune in the business in lands far removed from their home country.
entities.name: Overseas Trading Post

desc: This location is in the hands of the royal family of a previous ruler. The current monarch has no power over these lands.
entities.name: Panaqa

desc: The Papal Archives are a collection of Christian knowledge and history which are under the strict protection of the Papal States.
entities.name: Papal Archives

desc: Paper is the cornerstone of every realm, as it is used in every aspect of it, from administration to education and even trade. Thus, the Papermakers' Guild ensures the proper standard of production and volume, as well as a unique technique that involves the soaking, pulping or pressing of basic supplies such as linen, cotton or other plant fibers.
entities.name: Papermakers' Guild

desc: The increasing demand for Paper due to the printing industry forces innovative methods to up the production of Paper as well.
entities.name: Paper Manufactory

desc: Utilizing Cloth made from Cotton, a Paper Mill will be able to produce higher quantities of paper.
entities.name: Paper Mill

desc: Paper is a necessity for all types of advanced accounting, administration, and diffusion of knowledge. The Paper Workshop specializes in the creation of new Paper with lump, Fiber Crops and Lumber.
entities.name: Paper Workshop

desc: The clergy wants to extend its influence as far as they can, to be sure that all the population has access to the true faith. Even the smallest settlement is apt to having a priest to attend the spiritual needs of the local population.
entities.name: Parish Church

desc: If the commoners have legal permission to hunt, they will quickly establish specific grounds for that effect so that they can exploit the wildlife of any local forested area.
entities.name: Peasants Hunting Grounds

desc: As long as common levies need to be call, it is beneficial for the population to have local training grounds where they can practice the basics of combat, so that at least they know which is the correct side of a sword.
entities.name: Peasants Training Grounds

desc: The Peel Tower is a defensive building which enhances the local fortification and makes the land recover from the devastation inflicted during conflicts.
entities.name: Peel Tower

desc: Cultivating flowers and extracting their essence, the Perfumery produces a luxury good for the wealthy.
entities.name: Perfumery

desc: A small hut outside the of the borders of a community, where the sick and diseased are confined against their will to avoid the spread of plagues to the rest of the citizens.
entities.name: Pest House

desc: The district where the Phanariots, wealthy Greek merchants, reside in Constantinople.
entities.name: Phanariot District

desc: Piazza San Marco, or St. Mark's Square, is the principal public square in Venice, Italy. It is renowned for its stunning architecture, including St. Mark's Basilica, the Campanile, or the Doge's Palace, and serves as the social, religious, and political heart of the city.
entities.name: Piazza San Marco

desc: Commoners depend on the strength of their arms to provide them sustenance. Some may even turn to robbery and piracy, especially in shores that not receive the proper attention from the government, where they can establish hidden coves from where to launch their raids on unsuspecting vessels.
entities.name: Pirate Haven

desc: A wretched hive of scum and villainy, the most daring and illegal privateers, this building is the heart of a pirate republic.
entities.name: Pirate Stronghold

desc: Lively and notorious hubs where men of action, sailors, and merchants gathered. Located in key pirate ports and various coastal towns, these taverns play an essential role in pirate life. Here, crews relax, spend their plunder on alcohol, food, entertainment, and recruited new crew members.
entities.name: Harbor Tavern

desc: The Low Countries are highly susceptible to flooding, and the many disastrous floods that happened between the 11th and 14th centuries led to the creation of the Zuiderzee. This excessive flooding also caused coastal soils to become uselessly salinated. Thankfully, we now have the technology to reclaim this damaged land and use it productively for agriculture.
entities.name: Polders

desc: The Pomor Outpost serves as the primary building for the gathering of fur and fish. Many peasants seek out these buildings in Siberian wilds in the hope of making a living of the fur trade.
entities.name: Pomor Outpost

desc: Armed with guns and coastal batteries, a Feitoria is able to secure our influence within the area and allow our merchants to more freely trade.
entities.name: Feitoria

desc: Porcelain is a type of ceramics characterized by its strength and translucence due to the vitrification of the materials caused by high temperatures. The Porcelain Kiln specializes in the creation and decoration of such wares.
entities.name: Porcelain Kiln

desc: The production of Porcelain is the result of long alchemical experiments, allowing an alternative to the expensive import from overseas.
entities.name: Porcelain Manufactory

desc: The Port Authority oversees maritime traffic, enforcing regulations, collecting tariffs, and ensuring the safe flow of goods and business through the harbor.
entities.name: Port Authority

desc: The great port of Pisa is the lifeblood of its owner. It is the point where the wealth of distant seas flows back into our coffers, welcoming traders and goods from all ports.
entities.name: Porto Pisano

desc: Pottery making is one of humanity's oldest economic activities. The association of potters in guilds fosters the exchange of knowledge and the specialization of work, allowing for greater ceramic production.
entities.name: Potters' Guild

desc: The growing demand for commercialized ceramics has led to the creation of economies of scale. The production of manufactured goods using a common, organized workflow, renders pottery-making no longer a craft profession.
entities.name: Pottery Manufactory

desc: The growth in the supply generated by manufactured ceramics has led to its ultimate logical consequence: the development of mass production, in which industrial workers are now responsible for producing the ceramics.
entities.name: Pottery Mill

desc: Pottery is a staple in all population, from simple storage vessels to ornamentation objects. Streamlining its production in specialized workshops will serve to satisfy the people's need for pottery.
entities.name: Pottery Workshop

desc: An artisan skilled in crafting intricate Pounamou artifacts, revered for creating items of cultural and spiritual significance.
entities.name: Pounamou Carver

desc: The manipulation of the tide and any rivers that run through our realm, are vital for our survival. A Pound Lock Canal would ensure our mastery over life-giving water.
entities.name: Pound Lock Canal

desc: The introduction of new printing techniques allows printers to produce more Books than before.
entities.name: Printing Manufactory

desc: New techniques involving the usage of chemicals and more durable print plates allows the mass production of Books.
entities.name: Printing Mill

desc: Utilizing easily produced and replaceable parts the Printers Shop will reduce both our cost in labor and materials to produce and spread written documents among our population.
entities.name: Printers Shop

desc: Some places are more naturally suited to serve as a harbor than others, but with the proper infrastructure those conditions can be improved anywhere.
entities.name: Protected Harbor

desc: A branch office of our Chancery in the capital, this chancery office will both assist with our foreign diplomacy while also helping our local population in addressing their complaints.
entities.name: Provincial Chancery

desc: The provinces are the pillars that sustain the Middle Kingdom. To defend them against any attacker, garrisons need to be established with a permanent station of soldiers.
entities.name: Provincial Garrison

desc: The Pukara is a building placed in hill or mountainous terrain, and serves both as weapon storage and as a defensive fortification. They incorporate the difficulty of the terrain into their design, making them comparatively cheaper and easier to construct and maintain than regular forts.
entities.name: Pukara

desc: By increasing the quantity of our boilers for the process of concentrating the Saltpeter and improving their reliability, we will be able to increase the production of gunpowder for our troops without the reliance on costly imports.
entities.name: Putrefaction Mill

desc: Saltpeter is a valuable chemical compound which finds its uses as a fertilizer, salt for meat processing and as key ingredient for gunpowder. The Putrefaction Works serves as an alternative way to gain Saltpeter for cases where mining operations are not available.
entities.name: Putrefaction Works

desc: Deep in the heart of Tlemcen lies a fortified and beautifully illustrious palace complex. A symbol of local power and prosperity, the royal palace also serves as the administrative center of the seated dynasty. Besides its unparalleled beauty, it also serves as a defensive structure against foreign threats and prospecting conquerors.
entities.name: Qal'at al-Mashwār

desc: Quirinal Palace is the summer residence of the Popes, situated on the namesake hill overlooking the city of Rome.
entities.name: Quirinal Palace

desc: In order to protect the trade routes of Hindustan, a highway patrol has to be established. It is known as the Rahdar, where these men ensure the safety of trade within the area.
entities.name: Rahdar

desc: After completely rebuilding the religious site in Srirangam, it now stands as one of the greatest temples in all of Southern India.
entities.name: Ranganathaswamy Temple

desc: Ensuring that the location never falls into enemy hands, as well as a showcase of the prestige of its owner, the Red Fort has allowed us to project control over this location.
entities.name: Red Fort

desc: The Regimental Camp is a more efficient way of increasing the [
] by replacing the Training Fields in any [Rural Location].
entities.name: Regimental Camp

desc: A repaired and well-maintained line of fortifications will protect our borders against any foreign barbarian invasion.
entities.name: Great Wall of China

desc: The heart of our republic and the cornerstone of our administration is none other than the Republican Assembly, a place of deliberation where we elegantly exercise our power.
entities.name: Republican Assembly

desc: A small fortification mainly meant to protect caravans or small areas from raids.
entities.name: Ribāṭ

desc: The Navy Arsenal site, formerly a medieval naval dockyard called ''tercenas'', witnessed a shift during King D. Manuel I's construction of the Paço da Ribeira. The establishment of new tercenas, known as ''Ribeira das Naus'', to the west of the royal palace, played a crucial role in building ships for the Portuguese Discoveries. These shipyards, the largest in the Portuguese Empire, served as a model for overseas establishments, notably in Goa and Cochin.
entities.name: Ribeira das Naus

desc: The central national bank of Sweden it opperates under parliamentary oversight to ensure finantial stability and a strong currency for greater trading potential. Its presence will ensure the growth of Swedish economy.
entities.name: Riksbank

production_methods.name: Early Capital Buildings with Silver Decorations

desc: The Rock of Monaco is a tall monolith of the city of Monaco. While the great rock of its own is of little importance, the city of Monaco around it serves as a local pirate haven in the Mediterranean Sea.
entities.name: Rock of Monaco

desc: Represents a parliamentary borough with a very small electorate that can be corrupted, extorted or bribed to vote for a certain candidate.
entities.name: Rotten Borough

desc: The numerous admiralties in our nation have divided our interests, but it has allowed all of our provinces to maintain their own navies.
entities.name: Rotterdam Admiralty

desc: The Royal Academy of Arts is an institution dedicated to promoting, inspiring, and advancing the world of visual arts and architecture through education, exhibitions, and the celebration of artistic talent.
entities.name: Royal Academy of Arts

desc: The Royal Atarazanas of Sevilla are the most important shipyards in the Crown of Castile and one of the most important ones in the Iberian Peninsula, creating new ships for the Crown.
entities.name: Royal Atarazanas of Sevilla

desc: The Royal Audience and Chancery is a judiciary institution and our highest court with the authority over the entire nation, symbolizing our royal legal authority.
entities.name: Royal Audience and Chancery

desc: The pinnacle of the state, the Royal Court is the center of the monarchs power and splendor.
entities.name: Royal Court

desc: The vast Royal Garden is a piece of paradise on Earth, a place where the nobles of the court can relax and engage in superfluous pastimes while enjoying the magnificent cultivated nature of the garden.
entities.name: Royal Garden

desc: The Royal Society is a scientific institution dedicated to advancing scientific knowledge through research, publications, and the promotion of scientific excellence.
entities.name: Royal Society

production_methods.name: Ancient Great Wall of China Mainenance

desc: A gigantic series of walls and fortifications that spans the borders of a great Empire in multiple parts rather than a continuous wall, the Ancient Great Wall of China started to be built centuries ago. Although many dynasties have made repairs and expansions to it, centuries of abandonment have taken their toll on it and most of it is not much more than just ruins.
entities.name: Ancient Great Wall of China

desc: A small guild where textiles were handcrafted using local materials. It plays a vital role in local economies, providing clothing and trade goods.
entities.name: Rural Clothmaker

desc: A small rural workshop where skilled craftsmen transform locally sourced sand into glass through the art of glassblowing. The Rural Glassmaker supplies glass goods to local markets and provides a modest source of income for the surrounding community.
entities.name: Rural Glassmaker

desc: The Ṣafawiyya Order Hall is a building dedicated to the Sufi order of the Ṣafawiyya. While highly religious in nature, the building also serves as the military training grounds for the Kızılbaş.
entities.name: Ṣafawiyya Order Hall

desc: Salt has been a companion of human nutrition for millennia, and a highly appreciated good. Fortunately, the sea has it in abundance, so one must just capture its waters and let them dry to extract it. Alternatively, dried-up lakes or riverbeds are also good sources of easily obtainable salt.
entities.name: Salt Collector

desc: Produced through a labor-intensive process, Saltpeter is vital for the production of gunpowder, and thus state defense. It is extracted from nitrate-rich soils as well as manure or decaying organic matter.
entities.name: Saltpeter Guild

desc: With the increasing demand for gunpowder by our forces, a reliable production of artificial Saltpeter is a necessity.
entities.name: Saltpeter Workshop

desc: Sand has many uses, including as a building material, but certain types of sand are also ideal for glassmaking when heated. We can create sandpits to extract this resource for our various needs.
entities.name: Sand Pit

desc: Situated outside the busy noise of our cities, Sanssouci is a modest palace of one story, surrounding by vast gardens and vineyards.
entities.name: Sanssouci

desc: Forested areas provide ample material, but one cannot just simply make a house out of a tree. After a tree is felled, it needs to be processed in a sawmill before it can be put to good use. Through sawmills, raw timber is transformed intro proper wood.
entities.name: Sawmill

desc: Constructed in the place of an old hunting lodge of our dynasty, this palace will serve as the summer residence for our ruler's family.
entities.name: Schönbrunn Palace

desc: The School of Salamanca is an institution with the purpose of shaping modern thought in the disciplines of law, ethics, economy, and more.
entities.name: School of Salamanca

desc: The Schwaz Silver Mine is a prosperous mine of plentiful silver and copper ores. The resources gathered by the mining operations shall finance the diplomatic and military campaigns of its owner for centuries to come.
entities.name: Schwaz Silver Mine

desc: The Palace of Holyroodhouse stands as a symbol of one of the many architectures from the Scots Renaissance. A Grand Gothic palace, Holyroodhouse is one of the most treasured residences of the Scotland family.
entities.name: Palace of Holyroodhouse

desc: A specialized center where scribes meticulously copy manuscripts, the Scriptorium produces a variety of texts of religious, legal or even literary nature, in an effort to preserve and disseminate knowledge.
entities.name: Scriptorium

desc: A clergyman, elevated to the rank of cardinal, grants us significant influence within the Catholic Church.
entities.name: Cardinal Seat

desc: The Artillery Academy of Segovia is the first academy of its kind that focuses on the study of the military utilization of artillery, playing a critical role in the innovations of modern cannonry.
entities.name: Artillery Academy of Segovia

desc: The Seljuk Mint is a functional, secure site for producing coins, symbolizing political authority and fiscal stability.
entities.name: Seljuk Mint

desc: A Sergeantry is the building where sergeants live and train. Sergeants, derived from the Latin ''serviens'', 'servants', are the armed retinue that monarchs use in feudal systems, making them the core professional soldiers in their armies.
entities.name: Sergeantry

desc: This represents creating a new settlement with basics such as stores, basic construction support, and trade posts, to encourage migrants to the location.
entities.name: Settlement

desc: The Sevilla Bullfighting School is the first official institution dedicated to the training of matadors for this iconic cultural tradition.
entities.name: Sevilla Bullfighting School

desc: While our shepherds already breed sheep in our meadows and hills, we need a more farm-like approach to increase productivity. Sheep farms will breed larger numbers of sheep for greater output.
entities.name: Sheep Farms

desc: The Shipyard expands the capabilities of our port to new heights, increasing the number of vessels that can be serviced and built while also augmenting the amenities for the crew of those ships.
entities.name: Shipyard

desc: Land assigned to be privately owned by a particular family or temple, they operate almost as independent manors or estates, becoming a great source of influence and wealth for their owners.
entities.name: Shōen

desc: As the maritime influence of Siena expanded, this port was constructed to allow merchants to conduct their trade.
entities.name: Sienese Port

desc: The business with slaves is handled in the Slave Center. Wealthy entrepreneurs come here to acquire slave labor while raiders and pirates sell their captives.
entities.name: Slave Center

desc: A hub of trade where Slaves are bought and sold, fueling economies through forced labor.
entities.name: Slave Market

desc: The transportation of illegal goods as well as the commercial development of black markets hinge on the development of hidden coastal inlets or secluded harbors such as the Smugglers' Cove.
entities.name: Smugglers' Cove

desc: The Sofa Barracks is a specialized Barracks which allows the owner to recruit Sofa Infantrymen and Mandekalu Horsemen in the [
entities.name: Sofa Barracks

desc: The Sofa Stockade is in many aspects identical to a normal Stockade. The usage of Sofa Infantrymen instead of levies or militia makes the Sofa Stockade a formidable hindrance to pass though.
entities.name: Sofa Stockade

desc: People dedicated to the faith strive to rise above earthly matters and get close to divinity. As a result, places emerge where they can go commune with their faith, apart from any worldly attachments.
entities.name: Spiritual Retreat

desc: Court of law used by the tin miners of Cornwall and Devon, following the judicial independence granted to them by royal decree in 1305.
entities.name: Stannary Court

desc: Unlike its predecessor, the medieval Castle, the Star Fort is a very flat fortification composed of many triangular bastions at its corners and an additional ditch. This allows the defenders to counter enemy Artillery while still being able to keep climbing infantry at bay.
entities.name: Star Fort

desc: An increase in the reliability of our furnaces and production process made it possible to produce Steel on an economically beneficial scale.
entities.name: Steel Mill

desc: An important meeting place of brokers, merchants and investors, the Stock Exchange greatly facilitates business and the flow of shares in joint-stock companies.
entities.name: Stock Exchange

desc: A Stockade is an enclosure of usually wooden palisades or other forms defensive walls. Although not as impressive as a Castle, the Stockade can slow down enemy efforts to occupy the location.
entities.name: Stockade

desc: Stone is an excellent construction material used for houses, aqueducts, temples, bridges, and more. Unfortunately, it must be extracted, and high-quality building stone is not always abundant. To meet our needs, we can establish quarries in areas with good-quality material.
entities.name: Stone Quarry

desc: The Stroganov School of Iconic Art is devoted to the painting of religious icons typically associated with the Orthodoxy faith. Funded by the influential Stroganov dynasty, it acts as a springboard for aspiring painters.
entities.name: Stroganov School of Iconic Art

desc: A place for spiritual Sufi practice and education in religious mysticism, a Sufi Lodge is a center of Sufi devotion. Referred to by different names such as khānaqāh, zāwiya, ribāṭ, dargāh, and takya, its construction and funding represents an act of piety and serves as proof of the support of Sufi practices and the spread of Islam.
entities.name: Sufi Lodge

desc: A building constructed by local Islam converts that represents a more syncretic approach to faith.
entities.name: Sufi Mosque

desc: The cultivation of land and sugarcane is a wealthy endeavor. By erecting a Sugar Plantation we may succeed in getting a foothold in the lucrative Sugar trade.
entities.name: Sugar Plantation

desc: The Sukharev Tower is the center of education for those fit for a life at sea. It houses the School of Mathematics and Navigation, which teaches the art of seamanship and mathematics, in turn producing some of the finest sailors to walk this earth.
entities.name: Sukharev Tower

desc: Supervising the law of our country, the Supreme Court is the central institution to dictate and enforce our law.
entities.name: Supreme Court

desc: The Collegium Helveticum educates the most talented clergymen of the Swiss people. Although not on Swiss ground directly, the Collegium is a prime destination for aspiring theologians.
entities.name: Collegium Helveticum

desc: The Tambo is a supply depot of the Incas. The purpose of the Tambo varies significantly depending on the size of the structure. Smaller tambos serve as road stops for passing travelers while larger ones can even serve as an office for the province's administration.
entities.name: Tambo

desc: Responsible for the production of leather, the Tannery produces important items such as shoes, saddles, and book bindings. Utilizing advanced techniques to manipulate animal hides, the tanner ensures the durability as well as aestheticism of Leather.
entities.name: Tannery

desc: Advancements in chemistry make the process of tanning animal hides significantly shorter and produce higher quality Leather
entities.name: Tanning Manufactory

desc: With the use of new chemicals and more efficient production methods, our Leather production will be unrivaled.
entities.name: Tannery Mill

desc: The production of Leather has refined and allows for a wider scope of produced hide materials and increased output.
entities.name: Tanning Workshop

desc: Tar has been used since antiquity, as its sealing and waterproof properties are indispensable. Therefore, any forested area is fertile ground for kilns, used to extract tar from wood by the process of dry distilling it from it.
entities.name: Tar Kiln

desc: The traditional way of smelting iron and steel, they serve to provide the metal for the production of high quality tools and weapons.
entities.name: Tatara

desc: The Tax Assessor enforces the will of the ruler to collect the proper amount of taxation.
entities.name: Tax Assessor

desc: Teatro San Cassiano is the first public opera house in the world, marking a significant milestone in the history of performing arts and solidifying Venice's role as a leading cultural center.
entities.name: Teatro San Cassiano

desc: ''Tēlpōchcalli'', Nahuatl for 'house of young men', educates youth from fifteen onward for community service and war. Life there involves strenuous activities, cold baths, and frugal meals to strengthen the future warriors of our nation.
entities.name: Tēlpōchcalli

desc: A Temple is a place of worship dedicated for the religious duties of the Clergy. Although temples can come in different shapes and forms depending on the local religion, its purpose remains all the same.
entities.name: Temple

desc: The Terraces are sloped areas for the purpose of effective farming in the complex terrain of the Andes. Constructed on different height levels, the terraces can provide prime soil for many different crops in a close area.
entities.name: Terraces

desc: Powered by Waterwheels, a Textile Mill can mass-produce Cloth at rapid speed.
entities.name: Textile Mill

desc: Getting advantage of the Bock, the promontory that offers a natural fortification to the city, we have built a formidable complex of defenses that has made our city earn the nickname of ''Gibraltar of the North''.
entities.name: Bock Fortifications

desc: The Cipher Secretary is a state-run office that encrypts messages of merchants and diplomats to protect the interests of the Republic.
entities.name: The Cipher Secretary

desc: A building used by artists to perform plays, concerts and other theatrical works.
entities.name: Theater

desc: The administrative and military centers that make up the Decayed Theme System, these headquarters serve both as the rallying points for our imperial army and local governorship positions for our generals.
entities.name: Théma Headquarters

desc: Originally built on the orders of Constantine 'the Great', the walls elegantly guard one of Europe's most illustrious cities. Years later, when the double line of the walls was erected during the reign of Emperor Theodosius II, the city's defense became somewhat of a legend, being held in high regard and even considered impregnable.
entities.name: Theodosian Walls

desc: A great center of Tibetan Buddhism, it is the source of religious authority and Buddhism learning, as well as all monastic life.
entities.name: Great Tibetan Monastery

desc: The cultivation of Tobacco through the construction of a Tobacco Plantation will not only contribute to our prosperity, but also provide a share of the earnings of a wealthy trade.
entities.name: Tobacco Plantation

desc: A small fortification placed in or very close to a road, river crossing, or mountain pass, where a small contingent of guards can enforce the payment of a toll to be granted passage.
entities.name: Toll Castle

desc: Be it from the simple hammer to the first machine tools; Tools have been always a major part of our society. The Tools Guild specializes in producing these handy devices.
entities.name: Tools Guild

desc: With the expanding of our economy, no longer can our people rely on artisan-made tools. The establishment of proper workshops for the production of tools for our population and business has become a necessity.
entities.name: Tools Workshop

desc: Protecting the mouth of the Tagus River, the Tower of Belém is both a military fortress capable of safeguarding our port and a symbol of our maritime dominance.
entities.name: Tower of Belém

desc: Trading and commerce are the lifeblood of any prosperous city. The Trade Office ensures that our merchants gain more opportunities to establish profitable relations with foreign traders.
entities.name: Trade Office

desc: A vital point across our trade network, the Trading Hub constitutes a great place to sell and purchase many exotic and local goods.
entities.name: Trading Hub

desc: Built to secure spots for caravans, these Trans-Saharan outposts further allow their owners to spread their influence in the region.

desc: By using the locals of our conquered lands in the Balkans, we can alleviate pressure from our own bureaucracy, at the cost of empowering the locals in the area.
entities.name: Kocabaṣı Office

desc: Our commissioning of the ''Uffizi'' as the administrative heart of our new Grand Duchy creates not merely a seat of government, but a stage for our power — its long corridor soon to be lined with antiquities, sculptures, and canvases that announce our ruler's dynasty's mastery of both statecraft and beauty. Across the city, we are establishing a secret workshop in the Palazzo Vecchio, where alchemists and craftsmen perfect a soft-paste porcelain — the first produced in Europe, rivalling the precious wares imported at great expense from China. These twin achievements of administration and artisanal ambition mark the apex of our patronage, announcing to every court in Christendom that Tuscany under the Grand Dukes is as much a center of refinement as of power.
entities.name: Uffizi

desc: A center of thought and innovation, the University is home to bright minds of scientists and men of letters alike, all eager to promote growth and literacy.
entities.name: University

desc: An Urban Parliament Seat is a seat of political power of the local Burghers inhabiting the city. The presence of such buildings increases the influence of the guilds and merchants significantly.
entities.name: Urban Parliament Seat

desc: The American Academy of Arts and Sciences will cultivate every art and science which may tend to advance the interest, honor, dignity, and happiness of a free, independent, and virtuous people.
entities.name: American Academy of Arts and Sciences

desc: The First Bank of America will back our government and stabilize our currency.
entities.name: First Bank of America

desc: The Mint of America will regulate and improve the process of minting our currency.
entities.name: Mint of America

desc: The American Philosophical Society will promote useful knowledge and maintain our country at the forefront of scientific progress.
entities.name: American Philosophical Society

desc: This is a state-run shipyard, responsible for the rapid construction of powerful naval fleet, playing a key role in maritime dominance.
entities.name: Venetian Arsenal

desc: The Venetian Palaces are a status symbol of the wealthy members of the oligarchic nobility and influential guilds alike. As space is limited in Venice, the residents of the city construct palaces that aim for height instead. The marvelous architecture then attracts people from afar to witness the Venetian culture firsthand.
entities.name: Venetian Palaces

desc: A trade district of the state of Venice. As long this quarter exists, the Venetian merchants will have significant influence in the affairs of Constantinople.
entities.name: Venetian Quarter

desc: Venkaṭeśvara and Tirupati have seen an increase in influence after recent donations, bringing it to new heights within Tamil Nadu.
entities.name: Venkaṭeśvara Temple

desc: The Palace of Versailles is a major complex of the royal residence with several salons, halls, chambers, a chapel and even an opera. Diplomats and members of the high circles come regularly to the palace to do their bidding with the French royalty.
entities.name: Versailles

desc: The Viceroyalty is the crown's administrative and commercial seat in a colonial nation subject, built by the overlord in the subject's capital. It serves as the viceroy's residence and organizes imperial trade, channeling colonial revenue back to the overlord while supporting the colonial capital as a trade hub.
entities.name: Viceroyalty

desc: A shrine dedicated to a Islam saint who has greatly helped spread Islam in the area.
entities.name: Wālī's Shrine

desc: These walls allow Benin to prosper, keeping away any enemies that might seek to conquer it.
entities.name: Walls of Benin

desc: The defense of the people is what matters the most for the watch. It is why these walls exist: to ensure no civilian dies.
entities.name: Walls of Lucca

desc: Walls of Ston are a massive fortification chain protecting the trading city of Ragusa.
entities.name: Walls of Ston

desc: The War College serves as a place where veteran officers educate and train the coming generation of generals, ensuring the superiority of our army.
entities.name: War College

desc: The Warrior Lodge is a gathering place where our warriors train, recount their deeds, and prepare for the next battle. Rooted in our ancestral traditions, it serves as a local center of recruitment where War Party and Lodge Warriors can be trained.
entities.name: Warrior Lodge

desc: Being dedicated to the faith does not necessarily mean that one must renounce violence. As such, there are many monks who dedicate themselves not only to the cultivation of their faith, but also to their military prowess.
entities.name: Warrior Monks Training Grounds

desc: A Warrior Temple is the building from where Jaguar Warriors and Eagle Warriors, the elite warriors of Nahua countries, can be recruited.
entities.name: Warrior Temple

desc: A personal sponsor of our ruler, it serves as a place for the government's religious ceremonies, and for the funerary rites for our rulers and their families.
entities.name: Wat Chaiwatthanaram

desc: Military importance has increased much more in recent years. As such, better and new methods of producing armament for our soldiers are needed, and entire factories dedicated for such purpose are being established.
entities.name: Weapon Mill

desc: An association of craftsmen responsible for the production of various weapons, guilds such as this are a pillar for state defense, supplying the common soldier with arms tailored to specific martial needs and volume.
entities.name: Weaponsmith

desc: Various weapons such as swords, pikes, and bows make up the core Weaponry of every army. Using various materials, the Weaponry Manufactory creates melee and simple ranged weapons of all types.
entities.name: Weaponry Manufactory

desc: The ever-increasing demand of weapons both for our armies and our hunting operations requires us to increase the capabilities of the Weaponry production.
entities.name: Weapon Workshop

desc: The numerous admiralties in our nation have divided our interests, but it has allowed all of our provinces to maintain their own navies.
entities.name: West Friesland Admiralty

desc: The Wharf is a maritime structure at a port where ships can dock to transfer their cargo and to receive maintenance and repairs.
entities.name: Wharf

desc: Windmills come in various shape and sizes, as well as diverse sails structure and mechanisms, but they all serve to harness the power of wind to crush grain. As a result, the nutritious value of crops can be greatly improved, and transformed into a wider range of prepared foods.
entities.name: Windmill

desc: A humble guild where various raw sugars are fermented into rich and intoxicating beverages. Though simpler than traditional grape wine, these drinks are enjoyed by commoners and nobles alike, each region perfecting its own distinct flavors and techniques.
entities.name: Winery

desc: The ever-growing demand for refined fermented drinks has led to the creation of vast production centers where tradition meets industry. Ancient methods of wines are scaled up to serve bustling cities and far-reaching trade networks, ensuring no cup is left empty.
entities.name: Winery Manufactory

desc: The Bank of Amsterdam, also known as the Wisselbank of Amsterdam is an exchange bank which plays a significant role in the creation and defending of coinage standards. As the first of its kind, the Wisselbank of Amsterdam influences new state banks all across Europe.
entities.name: Wisselbank of Amsterdam

desc: Aligned with the movement of the sun, the Woodhenge of Cahokia serves as a method of tracking solar events.
entities.name: Woodhenge of Cahokia

desc: Originating from the residences of court nobility, the yakata are where the power of the warrior families congregates. Hosting facilities to gather their retainers as well as some elements for their defense, they host the best of each clan.
entities.name: Yakata

desc: Built exclusively as defensive positions in case of need, yamashiro are fortified hilltops with earthworks and wooden palisades rather than stone walls. The residences of the lords and retainers are at the foot of the hills, using only the fortified structures in case of an attack. Some of the most impressive yamashiro include fortifications on multiple hilltops, connecting them together by earthwork corridors and many layers of palisade fortifications.
entities.name: Yamashiro

desc: A show of force against other nations in Guinea, these walls show the might of the location to the neighbors.
entities.name: Zazzau Walls

desc: The numerous admiralties in our nation have divided our interests, but it has allowed all of our provinces to maintain their own navies.
entities.name: Zeeland Admiralty

desc: The seat of a local magistrate overseeing the counties' administration, they are the imperial appointees extending the authority of the Dragon Throne to the provinces.
entities.name: Zhīxiàn

desc: This palatial complex serves as a festival and garden area, with space for a future castle.
entities.name: Zwinger
